text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
Next, we've got a big announcement for
the
upcoming URA Finale!

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series's brightest stars will
vie for the
ultimate crown on the track
of their dreams!

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
And today, we'll be unveiling this year's

magnificent lineup of racers!
First up is...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, have you seen what's trending?! It's
pretty
much all URA Finale runners!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's really getting me pumped for
the big
day! Who are you cheering for?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, let's say it together! Three, two,
one...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> has been
recognized by
the public for all of her
efforts and
achievements...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's been invited to compete in the
grand URA
Finale with all of the other
star runners!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> and I are going
to make
our way through the
preliminaries and shoot for
the top!
